chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: Bake-Kurage first to put the body down and take the Charge, then All Streams Flow to the Sea into the Beetle, then the free Gorou attack on top of it.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: Pearl Barrage instead of All Streams Flow, exhausting a spare Coral Guard for the cost bonus -- and a defensive turn of two Coral Guards behind the Bake-Kurage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: All of the Block. Three Coral Guards sat in hand and I took none of them, so a debuff plus a follow-up hit lands on a bare 62.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. Against a large attack telegraph I would have led with a Coral Guard and kept the free Gorou attack for the chip, and I would not have spent the Charge on a turn I was going to be hit on.
